# Root help exposes the retained command families and global scope selectors.
exec card --help
stdout 'Run "card <command> --help" for more information'
stdout '--store=PATH'
stdout 'Physical Cardamom store directory'
stdout '--board=BOARD'
stdout 'Coordination board ID or exact name'
stdout 'Starting a board'
stdout 'board create'
stdout 'board edit'
stdout 'Planning work'
stdout 'edit'
stdout 'Inspecting work'
stdout 'Executing work'
stdout 'checkpoint approve'
stdout 'checkpoint deny'
stdout 'Recording work'
stdout 'log post'
stdout 'result set'
stdout '^Mail$'
stdout 'mail subscribe'
stdout '^Leases$'
stdout 'lease acquire'
stdout 'Running locally'
stdout 'info'
stdout 'web'

! exec card history
stderr 'error: unexpected argument history'

# Planning help names atomic document and relationship boundaries.
exec card create --help
stdout 'Create one issue and its labels, prerequisites, and containment parent'
stdout '--depends-on=ISSUE'

exec card apply --help
stdout 'Apply one version 1 issue graph atomically'
stdout 'Input is a strict JSON object with version, issues, and optional on_existing'
stdout 'Unknown fields are rejected'
stdout '--dry-run'

exec card edit --help
stdout 'Atomically edit requested scalar fields, labels, prerequisites, and containment'
stdout '--depends-on=TERM'
stdout 'No prefix or \+ adds; - removes'

# Execution and record help states the operation each command performs.
exec card claim --help
stdout 'Claim ready work or a specific issue'
stdout 'Routines may be claimed only by ID'

exec card release --help
stdout 'active claim into ready or waiting status'
stdout '--waiting=REASON'
stdout 'plain-text reason'

exec card close --help
stdout 'Close successfully completed issues'
stdout 'Checkpoints require approve or deny'
stdout 'Workstreams and routines require every'
stdout 'direct child to be terminal'

exec card cancel --help
stdout 'every non-terminal transitive dependent'

exec card reopen --help
stdout 'without claiming them or reopening prerequisites'

exec card checkpoint deny --help
stdout 'Deny a checkpoint and cancel its dependents'
stdout 'Optional Markdown reason'

exec card log post --help
stdout 'Post one immutable Markdown log entry attributed to the invocation actor'

exec card state set --help
stdout 'Set the complete mutable recovery State'
stdout 'explicitly empty body clears it'

exec card result set --help
stdout 'Set a nonblank durable result without closing the issue'

# Coordination and local-process help expose their ownership boundaries.
exec card mail recv --help
stdout 'Read unread actor mail by default'
stdout 'Global observation is always read-only'

exec card lease acquire --help
stdout 'Acquire an absent or expired resource lease'

exec card web --help
stdout 'Serve the API and browser application from embedded assets'

exec card board --help
stdout 'Create, select, and inspect coordination boards'
stdout 'board list'
stdout 'board create'
stdout 'board use'
stdout 'board show'
stdout 'board edit'

exec card board create --help
stdout 'Create one board in a project'
stdout 'A project is a repository or product namespace. A board is a non-nested shared'
stdout 'coordination context within one project'
stdout 'NAME is trimmed and must contain a non-whitespace character. Board names need'
stdout 'not be unique; duplicate exact names make name selection ambiguous'
stdout '--project=PROJECT'
stdout 'When omitted, use the'
stdout 'store.s sole project'

exec card board show --help
stdout 'When omitted, use the root board'
stdout 'checkout selection'
stdout 'store.s sole board'

exec card board edit --help
stdout 'When omitted, use the root board'
stdout 'checkout selection'
stdout 'store.s sole board'
stdout '--description=MARKDOWN'
stdout 'Replace the board description with Markdown'
stdout 'An empty --description value clears the board'
! stdout '--clear-description'

exec card init --help
stdout 'Initialize a physical Cardamom store and project namespace'
stdout '--board-name'
stdout '--no-board'
stdout '--no-config'
! stdout '--stealth'
